_readme: Step 8.1 SeedSourceProvider input — regional tourism/council/kibbutz-moshav accommodation directory pages that publish outbound links to independent zimmer/villa owner sites of their own free will. Every URL below was re-verified live on 2026-07-26 (curl -I, real HTTP response checked, no redirect to a suspended-hosting page) before being added/kept — see DECISIONS.md. 9 of the original 13 seeds had gone dark since they were first added (small .muni.il/.org.il council sites redirecting to their host's abuse/suspension page — a real, recurring failure mode for this kind of seed, worth re-checking periodically) and were replaced with live dedicated regional tourism sites, which in practice link out to individual zimmer/villa owners far more directly than a general council homepage does anyway. Add more entries as {"url": "https://...", "region": "north", "note": "why this is a good seed"} — this provider picks them up automatically, no code change needed.

seeds.note: Karmiel Municipality (עיריית כרמיאל), Galilee city — re-verified live 2026-07-26 (200).
Tirat Carmel Municipality, Carmel coast — re-verified live 2026-07-26 (redirects to its own real /Pages/default.aspx).
Mitzpe Ramon Local Council (המועצה המקומית מצפה רמון), deep Negev tourism town — re-verified live 2026-07-26 (redirects to its own real domain root).
The Kibbutz Movement (התנועה הקיבוצית) official site — cross-region, moshav/kibbutz hospitality directory — re-verified live 2026-07-26 (200).
תיירות גולן — the Golan's actual tourism site (has a dedicated 'צימרים ברמת הגולן' page); replaces the original golan.org.il council homepage, which now redirects to its host's abuse/suspension page.

GoGalil — הרשות לפיתוח הגליל (Galilee Development Authority) tourism portal covering Galilee/Golan/the Valleys, with a dedicated 'לינה בגליל' (lodging in the Galilee) section; replaces the original misgav.org.il/megido.org.il/jordanvalley.org.il council homepages, all three of which now redirect to their host's abuse/suspension page.

ארץ ים המלח — the Dead Sea region's actual tourism site, with a 'מקומות לינה' (places to stay) section; replaces the original dead-sea.org.il council page, which now redirects to its host's abuse/suspension page.

ערבה 4U — dedicated Arava tourism site, page titled 'צימרים בערבה' (zimmers in the Arava); replaces the original arava.co.il/eilot.org.il council homepages, both of which now redirect to their host's abuse/suspension page.

אילת+ — Eilat's official tourism guide site (hotels/accommodation/attractions/business directory); replaces the original eilat.muni.il/תיירות page, which now redirects to its host's abuse/suspension page.
עמותת תיירות כרמלים — the Carmel coast tourism association, with a dedicated 'אירוח כפרי' (rural lodging) product category — verified live 2026-07-26 (200).
מועצה אזורית הגליל העליון (Upper Galilee Regional Council) — verified live 2026-07-26 (200).
GoNegev — regional Negev tourism site explicitly listing 'צימרים ומלונות' (zimmers and hotels) — verified live 2026-07-26 (200).
תיירות הר הנגב — Har Negev regional tourism site (covers Ramat HaNegev/Mitzpe Ramon area accommodations) — verified live 2026-07-26 (200).
